findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：拉美政府常干預經濟，政策變動（含關稅、進口關稅與限制、出口稅、進口限制）可能對 MELI 業務造成不利影響；另受 OFAC 制裁規範。
findings.excerpt: Our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects may be adversely affected by changes in government policies or regulations, including such factors as: exchange rates and exchange control policies; inflation rates; interest rates; tariff and inflation control policies; price control policies; import duties and restrictions;

findings.claim: 墨西哥海關與關稅改革自 2026-01-01 生效，簡易快遞稅率由 19% 升至 33.5%，美加原產豁免。
findings.source: shopappy.com 分析 mercadolibre mexico flank 2027
findings.excerpt: Signal 2: Mexico’s customs and tariff reform, in force since January 1, 2026, lifted the simplified courier rate on shipments valued up to USD 2,500 from 19% to 33.5% while exempting US and Canadian origin goods, re-pricing the cross-border shelf rather than merely taxing it.

findings.claim: 巴西恢復 US$50 以下包裹聯邦進口稅免稅，預期有利中國賣家。

note: 搜尋未找到 Section 232 或實體清單／出口管制直接影響 MELI 的來源。間接線索：墨西哥 2026-01-01 關稅改革調高小包裹稅率（豁免美加原產）、巴西恢復 US$50 以下包裹免聯邦進口稅，皆為搜尋摘要轉述，未讀頁面。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
